findings.what_happened: The model incorrectly stated using internal knowledge that 'Love No Limit' was written by Kenton Nix, when the song was actually co-written by Kenny Greene and Dave Hall.
findings.quote: "Love No Limit" is a song by Mary J. Blige, co-written by Kenton Nix and produced by Dave Hall. Wait, checking the songwriter credit: "Love No Limit" was written by Kenton Nix.
